mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material (material_name, material_type, course_id, uploader_id, file_url, storage_key, original_file_name, content_type, file_size, download_score, download_count, description, reject_reason, status, keyword, create_time, update_time, is_deleted, revision, upload_rewarded) VALUES (#{materialName}, #{materialType}, #{courseId}, #{uploaderId}, #{fileUrl}, #{storageKey}, #{originalFileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{downloadScore}, #{downloadCount}, #{description}, #{rejectReason}, #{status}, #{keyword}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted}, #{revision}, #{uploadRewarded})
mapper.update: UPDATE material SET status=#{status},reject_reason=#{reason},update_time=NOW() WHERE material_id=#{materialId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status=0 AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE material SET upload_rewarded=1 WHERE material_id=#{materialId} AND upload_rewarded=0

UPDATE material SET material_name=#{materialName},material_type=#{materialType},course_id=#{courseId}, file_url=#{fileUrl},storage_key=#{storageKey},original_file_name=#{originalFileName},content_type=#{contentType}, file_size=#{fileSize},download_score=#{downloadScore},description=#{description},keyword=#{keyword}, revision=#{revision},status=0,reject_reason=NULL,update_time=#{updateTime} WHERE material_id=#{materialId} AND revision=#{revision}-1 AND status=2 AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE material SET download_count = download_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
UPDATE material SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE material_id = #{materialId}
UPDATE material SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE material SET status = 2, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE material SET status = 0, reject_reason = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND status = 2 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT material_type AS category_id, CASE material_type WHEN 1 THEN 'PDF' WHEN 2 THEN 'Word' WHEN 3 THEN 'Excel' WHEN 4 THEN 'PPT' WHEN 5 THEN '图片' ELSE '其他' END AS category_name FROM material WHERE is_deleted = 0
